title: Umm Kulthum
summary: Umm Kulthum was an Egyptian singer from a Nile Delta village; sources give her birth year as 1898, 1904 or 1908. After moving to Cairo in the early 1920s she became perhaps the most famous singer in the modern Arab world, with weekly Thursday-night radio broadcasts. She died on 3 February 1975, and her funeral is reported to have drawn between three and four million people.

uncertainty.note: Birth year conflicts across opened pages: 1898 (Arab News), 1904 official with a birth certificate reading 1898 (Encyclopedia.com), 1908 (Al Jadid). Move to Cairo is dated 1923 (Arab News), 1919-1922 (Encyclopedia.com) or 1924 (Al Jadid). Death: Encyclopedia.com gives 3 February 1975, Arab News the same date.
